operating_notes.text: Secured ₹36 Cr order from Eastern Railway for auto signalling using Multi Section Digital Axle Counter.
Texmaco launched invariz Global Capability Centers powered by ServiceNow expecting $100M+ in incremental revenue by 2030.
Secured ₹187.28 Cr order from Southern Railway for interlocking arrangement at 183 non-interlocked gates.
Secured ₹130.22 Cr order from Kochi Metro Rail Limited for Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Ballastless Track for Phase 2 Corridor.
Secured ₹57.15 Cr order from Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited for supply and commissioning of 2 BTAP Rakes and 2 Nos. of BVCM.
Secured ₹27.82 Cr order from Hindalco Industries Limited for supply of 1 BTAP rake and one Brake Van, to be executed within 10 months from the date of PO.
Secured LOA from South African Train Operating Company for over 2,235 freight wagons and 30 diesel locomotives valued upwards of ₹4,045 Crores.
Secured ₹191.99 Cr orders from South Central Railway for Automatic Block Signalling System to be executed within 480 days.
FY26 freight car deliveries were 8,372 units and foundry volume 34,000 MT; Q4FY26 was 2,196 freight cars and 8,964 MT.
Around 70% of the wagon order book was from private customers as of 31 March 2026.
Texmaco's share of the Indian private wagon market is around 40-45%, higher for specialised wagons.
Trinity acquired a 32% participation in railcar leasing JV Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing Pvt. Ltd. (TTRL).

Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing Private Limited issued 3,16,70,588 shares and 76,893 CCDs to TrinityRail Global Inc., revising holding to 34% (plus 1 share) for Touax, 34% (minus 1 share) for Texmaco, and 32% for TrinityRail.
Received ₹0.74 Cr (incl taxes) LoA from South Western Railway for nylon mesh on TTC and portals in SBC division, executable in 10 months.
Share of private sector and export orders in Freight Car Division increased from 21% in FY25 to 79% in FY26 and further to 96.4% in Q1 FY27
Bright Power (Electrical Infra) revenue increased 76.8% YoY to INR175 crores in Q1FY27
Rail Infra & Green business reported positive EBIT margin of 1.4% in Q1FY27 compared to EBIT loss in corresponding quarter last year
Signed MoU with The Signalling Company NV (Belgium) for ETCS and Kavach signalling development in India.
Won ₹77.76 Cr purchase order (incl. taxes) from IVC Logistics to supply 3 rakes of ACT1 wagons and 1 BVCM wagon per rake by March 31, 2027.
Texmaco Defence Technologies had FY26 net worth of ₹0.01 Cr and zero revenue before the ₹200 Cr investment agreement.
Texmaco Defence Technologies Limited reported total income of ₹0.01 Cr in FY26 and nil turnover for the last 3 years.
Entered into a 12-month exclusive MoU with Germany's BVV on 27 August 2026 to explore a JV for railway wheels, wheelsets, and axles.
Received Letter of Award of USD 135M from Tsiko Africa Logistics and Barberry Holdings for Wabtec ES43ACi locomotives, executable within 20-24 months of definitive agreement.
Awarded ₹24.48 Cr order (incl. taxes) from Transport Corporation of India Limited for 1 rake of ACT-1 and BVCM wagons to be executed within 16 weeks from LOI.

Received two wagon orders aggregating ₹131.36 Cr (incl. taxes): ₹24.48 Cr from TCI for 1 rake of ACT-1 and BVCM wagons (16 weeks), and ₹106.88 Cr from JV Touax Texmaco for 4 rakes of BFNS22.9 wagons and 4 BVCM wagons (by 26 May 2027).
Bagged ₹27.82 Cr order (incl. taxes) from Hindalco Industries for 1 BTAP rake and 1 Brake Van for Aditya Expansion Project, execution within 8 months of PO.
Subsidiary Texmaco Defence Technologies signed SPA to acquire 100% of Indolem Technologies Systems for ₹8 lakh cash.

Received an amendment from Ministry of Railways for an additional 1,020 BOXNS wagons, increasing the total contract value to ₹1,786.74 Cr (including taxes), with execution to be completed by 11 June 2027.

timeline.summary: Adventz Securities Enterprises Limited (PAN: AACCP4398M) confirmed no new encumbrances on Texmaco Rail & Engineering shares during FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings Ltd. declared no new encumbrances on Texmaco Rail & Engineering shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Duke Commerce Limited, acting with concert parties, disclosed no new encumbrances on Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited shares beyond prior disclosures for FY2026.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹7.67 Cr order from South Western Railway for OHE and PSI maintenance.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹36 Cr order from Eastern Railway for auto signalling equipment.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering launched 'invariz' Global Capability Centers powered by ServiceNow to enter AI-led global services.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹187.28 Cr order from Southern Railway for gate interlocking arrangements.
Zuari Industries Limited’s Yadvinder Goyal declares no new encumbrances on Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹130.22 Cr order from Kochi Metro Rail Limited for ballastless track and connections.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹57.15 Cr order from Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited for BTAP rakes and BVCM.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹27.82 Cr order from Hindalco Industries for 1 BTAP rake and one Brake Van.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,166.97 Cr (-13.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹57.68 Cr (+45.0% YoY).
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a landmark South African rail order opportunity worth over ₹4,045 Cr on May 12, 2026.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited hosted an analysts/investor conference call on May 13, 2026, at 2:00 PM IST to discuss Q4 and FY2026 results via **KUMAR SULTANIA Sandeep Kumar Sultania**, CFO.
On 15 May 2026, Texmaco Rail & Engineering responded to IiAS proxy advisory recommendations regarding the Long Term Incentive Plan.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured two Letters of Acceptance worth ₹191.99 Cr from South Central Railway for signalling works.

Texmaco Rail & Engineering's 13 May 2026 Q4FY26 call set a Vision 2030 of 2x revenue and mid-teens EBITDA, disclosed a ₹700 Cr contingency provision from free reserves that drew an auditor qualification, and put capex at ₹1,500-2,000 Cr.
On 23 May 2026, Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured a ₹28.58 Cr order from Vedanta Aluminium for wagons and a brake van.
Texmaco Rail & Engineering secured shareholder approval for its Long Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) Scheme 2026 through postal ballot with 95.97% votes in favour.
Texmaco Rail entered into an amended joint venture agreement with Trinity Rail Global Inc on 2 June 2026, reducing its stake in Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing from 50% to 34%.
On 3 June 2026, Texmaco Rail & Engineering announced that TrinityRail Global joined its railcar leasing joint venture TTRL with a 32% stake alongside Touax Group.
Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing JV allotted 32% stake to TrinityRail Global Inc., revising Texmaco's holding to 34% (minus 1 share).
Received ₹0.74 Cr LoA from South Western Railway for bird nest prevention mesh to be executed in 10 months.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹756.68 Cr (-16.9% YoY), net profit ₹50.07 Cr (+70.7% YoY).
Texmaco Rail reported Q1FY27 standalone revenue of ₹753 Cr, EBITDA margin of 10.8%, and order book of ₹9,923 Cr as of June 30, 2026.
Signed MoU with The Signalling Company NV (Belgium) to collaborate on ETCS and Kavach train protection solutions for India.
Bagged ₹77.76 Cr wagon supply order from IVC Logistics Limited for 3 rakes of ACT1 wagons, due by March 2027.
Texmaco Rail entered into an SSSA for up to ₹200 Cr investment in subsidiary Texmaco Defence Technologies Ltd by Calculus, diluting parent stake to 70%.
Texmaco Rail invested ₹6.88 Cr in subsidiary Texmaco Defence Technologies Ltd, diluting parent stake to 70% as Vagus Def Tech acquired 30%.
Executed an exclusive 12-month MoU with Bochumer Verein Verkehrstechnik GmbH (BVV) to explore a joint venture in India for railway wheels and wheelsets.
Received USD 135M Letter of Award for diesel-electric locomotives from Tsiko Africa Logistics and Barberry Holdings.
Texmaco Rail secured a ₹24.48 Cr (incl. taxes) order from Transport Corporation of India for 1 rake of wagons, executable in 16 weeks.
Received wagon orders aggregating ₹131.36 Cr (incl. taxes) from TCI (₹24.48 Cr) and JV Touax Texmaco Railcar Leasing (₹106.88 Cr).
Secured ₹27.82 Cr order from Hindalco Industries to supply 1 BTAP rake and 1 Brake Van within 8 months.
Texmaco Rail held its 28th AGM on 18 September 2026; all resolutions passed with requisite majority.
Texmaco Rail's subsidiary Texmaco Defence signed an SPA to acquire 100% of Indolem Technologies Systems for ₹8 lakh.
Texmaco Rail gets MoR amendment for 1,020 BOXNS wagons, total contract value ₹1,787 Cr
Crisil Ratings assigned Crisil A+/Stable rating to Texmaco Rail's long-term bank facilities.
